errors.description: timer_count_q is a multi-bit value produced in timer_clk and sampled directly in apb_clk without a bundled-data handshake or hold guarantee.
tick_pulse_q is a one-cycle timer_clk pulse consumed directly in apb_clk, so the event can be missed or sampled metastably.
tick_toggle_q reconverges with a one-sample apb_clk history, allowing metastability or double-counting in apb_event_o.
capture_mode_sync_q receives independently synchronized bits from encoded control vector capture_mode_q before decoding in apb_clk, so transient illegal modes can be observed.
timer_rst_n is used as data inside apb_clk logic, so reset deassertion can asynchronously change destination state.
trace_snapshot_q combines timer_clk payload state with apb_clk status state in trace_clk without a cross-domain snapshot protocol.
